sections.title: From Farm to Gut: Food, Factories, and Physiology
sections.description: From Farm to Gut will explore the biology that underlies food and feeding. We begin by looking at sources of food and the genetics behind food. We will examine how food is processed and delivered for widespread consumption. The second part of the course will focus on how the consumption of food affects your physiology, specifically looking at how food in your gut signals your body and brain. Intermediate level coursework in genetics, cell and molecular biology is encouraged.
